title: Start a community conversation
caption: We would love to hear from you: [question related to your business]. Share your experience in the comments and help us shape what comes next.
visual: A welcoming team or product photo, or a simple text update.
cta: Tell us what you think in the comments.
bestTime: Try an evening when your community is active

title: Weekend offer
caption: Your weekend just got better. Enjoy [offer] at [business name] from [start date] to [end date]. Limited availability—save this post so you do not miss it.
visual: A clean product or service photo with the offer and end date overlaid.
cta: Message us or visit [link] to claim the offer.

title: New arrival reveal
caption: Just arrived: [product name]. We chose it because [one customer benefit]. Available now in [store/location] while stock lasts.
visual: One hero product image plus two close-up detail shots.
cta: Which detail do you want to see next?

title: Behind the scenes
caption: What happens before [product/service] reaches you? Here is a quick look at the care, people, and process behind [business name].
visual: Three to five process photos from preparation to finished result.
cta: Ask us anything about how we work.

title: Customer success story
caption: [Customer type] came to us with [challenge]. Together, we focused on [approach], helping them reach [verified outcome]. The biggest lesson: [practical insight].
visual: A permission-approved customer image or a simple before-and-after graphic.
cta: Facing a similar challenge? Let us talk.

title: One practical tip
caption: A quick way to improve [topic]: [specific tip]. Start with [first step], then check [simple measure]. Small changes are easier to repeat—and repetition creates progress.
visual: A bold tip headline with one supporting image or diagram.
cta: Save this for the next time you work on [topic].

title: Myth versus fact
caption: Myth: [common misconception]. Fact: [accurate correction]. What matters instead is [useful explanation].
visual: Two-slide myth/fact comparison followed by one action slide.
cta: What other question should we break down?

title: Meet the team
caption: Meet [team member], our [role]. They help customers by [responsibility] and are known around here for [human detail].
visual: A natural workplace portrait rather than a formal headshot.
cta: Say hello to [name] in the comments.

title: Why we started
caption: We started [business name] after noticing [problem]. Our goal was simple: [mission]. Today, that still shapes how we [specific customer commitment].
visual: An early photo, founder portrait, or meaningful workspace detail.
cta: What made you start your journey?

title: This or that
caption: Help us choose: [option A] or [option B]? Both have [shared benefit], but only one can be featured next.
visual: A split-screen comparison with clear A and B labels.
cta: Comment A or B—or vote in our Story.

title: Frequently asked question
caption: You asked: [question]? The short answer is [answer]. Here is what to consider before you decide: [two useful points].
visual: The question as large text with the answer in the caption or next slide.
cta: Send us the next question you want answered.

title: Limited appointments
caption: A few [service] appointments are still open for [day/week]. If you have been waiting for [benefit], this is your sign.
visual: A polished result photo with available dates in a subtle overlay.
cta: DM ‘BOOK’ or use [booking link] to reserve a slot.

title: Before and after
caption: From [starting point] to [finished result]. We focused on [technique/product] to create [benefit] while keeping [customer priority] in mind.
visual: Matched before-and-after photos with customer permission.
cta: Save this as inspiration for your next appointment.

title: Dish spotlight
caption: Today’s craving: [dish name]. Made with [key ingredients] and finished with [distinctive detail]. Available [days/times].
visual: A close, naturally lit photo showing texture and portion.
cta: Tag the person you would share this with.

title: From kitchen to table
caption: It starts with [ingredient/process] and ends at your table. Swipe to see how our team prepares [dish] from start to finish.
visual: Four process frames: ingredients, preparation, finishing, plated dish.
cta: Which step surprised you most?

title: Review highlight
caption: “[Short approved customer review.]” Feedback like this reminds our team why [customer promise] matters every day. Thank you, [customer name/initials].
visual: A branded quote card or customer-approved photo.
cta: Already worked with us? Share your experience at [review link].

title: Community question
caption: We want your take: what is the hardest part about [relevant topic]? Choose one: A) [option], B) [option], or C) [option].
visual: A simple branded question card with three choices.
cta: Reply with A, B, or C and tell us why.

title: Five-minute routine
caption: No full workout window today? Try this five-minute [goal] routine: [move 1], [move 2], and [move 3]. Adjust intensity to your level and stop if something feels wrong.
visual: One movement per slide with time, form cue, and modification.
cta: Save the routine and tell us when you finish.

title: Member milestone
caption: Celebrating [member name/initials] for [verified milestone]. Their consistency with [habit] made the difference—and we are proud to support the journey.
visual: A member-approved photo or milestone board.
cta: Drop a 👏 to celebrate this win.

title: Mini case study
caption: Challenge: [specific problem]. Approach: [what you changed]. Verified result: [measurable outcome]. Takeaway: [lesson others can apply].
visual: Four slides covering challenge, approach, result, and takeaway.
cta: Message us if you want to explore this approach for your business.

title: Industry point of view
caption: A common conversation in [industry] right now is [trend]. Our view: [clear position], because [reason/evidence]. The practical implication for [audience] is [action].
visual: A concise quote card featuring the central point of view.
cta: Do you agree? Add your perspective below.

title: Restock alert
caption: Back by popular request: [product name] is restocked. Available in [variants/sizes] from today.
visual: A short unpacking video or shelf-restock sequence.
cta: Tap [link] or visit us before it sells out again.
bestTime: As soon as stock is available

title: Product comparison
caption: Choosing between [product A] and [product B]? Pick A when you need [benefit]. Pick B when [different need]. Here is the simplest way to decide.
visual: Side-by-side cards comparing three meaningful features.
cta: Save this guide or ask us for a recommendation.

title: How our service works
caption: New here? Working with [business name] takes three simple steps: 1) [step], 2) [step], 3) [step]. You will always know what happens next.
visual: One clear step per slide using consistent numbers and icons.
cta: Ready to begin? Start at [link].

title: Monthly recap
caption: This month at [business name]: [highlight 1], [highlight 2], and [highlight 3]. Thank you to everyone who helped move the work forward. Next month, we are focused on [priority].
visual: A five-slide recap with one highlight per slide and a next-month preview.
cta: Which update should we share more about?
bestTime: Last weekday of the month, 10 AM

title: Event invitation
caption: Join us for [event name] on [date] at [time]. Expect [two concrete takeaways or activities]. [Free/paid] entry with [registration requirement].
visual: A clear event card with date, time, location, and one focal image.
cta: Reserve your place at [link].
